note: Winston County AL publishes no county zoning layer; Alabama counties generally do not zone. Largest city Haleyville publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Zone1000.pdf) with an ordinance PDF; no queryable zoning polygons. Double Springs and other towns show no published zoning service. The county parcel viewer (isv.kcsgis.com) is a viewer with non-commercial terms and no zoning layer found.
